name: Wolf Heart Sample
summary: Wolf Heart Sample is bound for the Crossroads, carrying diseased wolf tissue from Lordaeron to Kalimdor. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks to learn what northern toxins do to the Barrens’ native beasts.

sections.title: A Toxic Export
sections.body: Wolf Heart Sample began with plagued wolves in Lordaeron’s ruins. Apothecary Renferrel gathered the hearts, and they were packed for the journey across the Great Sea. The Forsaken’s Royal Apothecary Society seeks greater knowledge of venom, blights, and biological reagents. A courier carries the parcel to the Crossroads in the Barrens, linking Undercity’s experiments in the scarred Eastern Kingdoms with Kalimdor’s frontier outposts.

sections.title: Helbrim's Research
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim receives Wolf Heart Sample. Helbrim studies how toxins from Lordaeron’s Scourge-ravaged lands affect the native wildlife of Kalimdor. The toxicity preserved in the wolf hearts may reveal properties that can improve Forsaken poisons and elixirs far from home.

faq.q: What is the Wolf Heart Sample?
faq.answer: Wolf Heart Sample is tissue preserved from blighted wolves in Lordaeron. Its lingering toxicity from the northern plagues gives the Royal Apothecary Society material for studying virulent poisons.

faq.q: Who sent this sample to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge sent the sample from Undercity, using wolf hearts Apothecary Renferrel had sent her from Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Helbrim want it?
faq.answer: Helbrim studies how toxins from Lordaeron affect Kalimdor’s native beasts. He plans to examine the sample’s venomous properties to advance Forsaken alchemical compounds and poisons.

faq.q: Where does the sample need to be delivered?
faq.answer: Bring the sample to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads, a major Horde settlement in the heart of the Barrens.

angles.text: As an undead, you carry the Royal Apothecary Society’s research into Kalimdor, where it tests northern concoctions against unfamiliar wildlife.
As a member of the Horde, you help carry research reagents across the sea, linking Undercity with Horde outposts in the Barrens.
